text:
The dish looks like cottage cheese in a bowl about 15 cm across. The cheese covers roughly 10-11 cm of the bowl and is heaped a little.

For volume, I treat it as a dome about 10.5 cm across and 4 cm tall. A spherical cap with radius 5.25 cm and height 4 cm has volume πh(3r² + h²)/6 = π·4·(82.7 + 16)/6 ≈ 207 mL. Cottage cheese curds pack loosely, so I take about 0.9 g/mL, which gives roughly 185 g. Allowing for the bowl's curve and uncertainty in the height, I settle on about 180 g.

Cottage cheese runs about 98 kcal per 100 g for the 4% fat type, so 180 g is about 176 kcal, which I round to 175.
